verse.verse_1: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.
verse.verse_2: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,
verse.verse_4: Master of the Day of Judgment,
verse.verse_5: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.
verse.verse_7: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.
